blocks.packageReason: Package for the effect only, justified in the header (request R-B18-29); the trigger is a separate block and the class owns no condition. Tier C: nothing to bind (the parent gets no closure). Users (2 attrs, both in Avenger 5030): attr 3 Attack and attr 4 Sp. Atk, each 0.05 (5%). The share is stored as a fraction (0.05) and shown to staff as a whole percent (5) through fractionAsPercentCodec; 5 / 100 is exactly the literal 0.05, so a rebuild is identical. Oddities, not fixed: (a) the parent `multiplier` stays 1, so code that reads it (the studio's reflection) sees 1, not the formula; (b) the multiplier is applied on every stat query including previews and the AI, and the party is read live each time; (c) the count is not capped (a full party of 5 fainted allies gives x1.25); (d) a party of the enemy side counts the enemy party, including benched members; (e) the class declares only the offensive stats in its type, but any stat would work.

blocks.packageReason: Package for the effect only, justified in the header (request R-B18-26); the trigger (cancel.stat-drop) and the drop test (stage.just-changed lowered, the gate) are separate blocks. User (1 attr): Change of Heart (5234 attr 1). Class change (pure move of the old canApply into guards / gate / residual, same order). OPEN REQUEST R-B18-25: `source !== null` has no atom, so it stays in the residual; when the atom exists it moves into the gate. SUSPECTED GAME BUG, NOT FIXED: no code dispatches PreStatStageChangeAbAttr (grep over src finds only the type and the phase's other keys; decomp-l2-reach.json already lists cancel.stat-drop as never evaluated), so Change of Heart's reversal never happens in a real battle; ReflectStatStageChangeAbAttr works because it has its own dispatch call. Second oddity: the parameter type says `source` is OMITTED (undefined) for self-inflicted drops, but the test is `source !== null`, which is true for undefined, so if the class were ever dispatched it would also reverse a drop the holder caused itself. Third: the boost goes out with selfTarget true and the ability pop-up shows (showAbility true), apply sets `cancelled` even for simulated calls.
